Launch the app; the only reproduction step captured in the packet is the launch lifecycle event, present in all events considered.
At launch, bootstrap fails in src/app/main.ts at line 12 in the function bootstrap, raising Error: Bootstrap failed: config missing.
The packet contains no further user actions or navigation between launch and the failure, so there is nothing more to replay beyond starting the app.

summary.text: The incident is an "Error: Bootstrap failed: config missing" thrown during app launch, seen across the 2 events analyzed.
